title: AI Chatbot Developer
description: Build an intelligent conversational AI assistant for product discovery using RAG, Python, and LLM APIs.
introduction: We are looking for a motivated AI Chatbot Developer Intern to join our team and help build an intelligent product discovery assistant. You will work directly with our founding engineers on a production system serving real users.
responsibilities: Design and develop a conversational AI chatbot for product and business discovery
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline using vector databases
Integrate with free LLM APIs (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter)
Build REST API endpoints using Python and Flask
Write clean, documented, and testable code
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
requirements: Basic understanding of Python programming
Familiarity with REST APIs and HTTP concepts
Interest in AI/ML and natural language processing
Ability to learn quickly and work independently
Good communication skills
preferred: Prior exposure to LLM APIs or prompt engineering

title: Frontend Intern (React)
description: Work on modern React applications and learn from experienced developers building production UIs.
introduction: Join our frontend team to build beautiful, responsive user interfaces for our web applications.
responsibilities: Develop responsive UI components using React.js
Implement designs following provided specifications
Write clean, reusable component code
Collaborate with backend developers on API integration
requirements: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Familiarity with React.js fundamentals
Understanding of component-based architecture

title: Backend Intern (Python + Flask)
description: Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python and Flask for our platform.
introduction: We are seeking a Backend Development Intern to help build and maintain our API infrastructure.
responsibilities: Develop RESTful API endpoints using Flask
Write database queries and manage data models
Implement authentication and authorization
Write unit tests for backend services
requirements: Basic Python programming skills
Understanding of REST API concepts
Familiarity with SQL databases

title: Full Stack Intern
description: Get hands-on experience with both frontend and backend development on our stack.
introduction: This role offers a comprehensive full-stack development experience across our entire technology stack.
responsibilities: Develop features across frontend and backend
Build React components and Flask API endpoints
Work with databases and data models
requirements: Basic knowledge of both frontend and backend development
Familiarity with React and Python

title: 🚀 Startup Builder Internship (You + Your Best Friend)
description: You apply with your best friend. We are hiring a PAIR. Perfect for students obsessed with startups and founders.
introduction:
If you and your best friend are obsessed with startups, talk about founders, ideas, growth, and dream of building your own company one day — this role is for you.

We are preferably looking for students from Bangalore, Pune, Chennai, or Hyderabad. But honestly city doesn't matter. If you're out of the box, high-energy, and we like you — we will hire you even if you're from any other city.
responsibilities: Visit nearby local shops and explain the app
Capture real reactions and conversations on video
Edit videos to ~1 minute Instagram reels
Post consistently to build ekthaa's presence
Learn user acquisition, sales, and content creation in real life
requirements: You and your best friend both apply together
Deep interest in the startup ecosystem
Extroverts who love talking to strangers
Can confidently explain an app in 1–2 minutes
Comfortable with basic editing apps like CapCut / VN
preferred: Students who want to become startup founders someday
From Bangalore, Pune, Chennai, or Hyderabad
Can give 30–60 minutes a day consistently

title: Social Media & Content Intern
description: Join Ekthaa as a Social Media & Content Intern and help us grow our startup using AI tools, creative content, and social media. If you can do any one skill from editing, writing, or content creation you're in.
introduction:
Ekthaa is building a platform to help local businesses get discovered and grow. We're looking for smart, creative, and hungry-to-learn interns who want to build real startup experience in content, AI tools, and social media.
This is a zero-pressure, flexible, unpaid internship where you can contribute just 1–2 hours a day. You don't need to know everything - if you're good at any one skill like editing, writing, or content creation, you can join.
If you perform exceptionally well, you may be considered for a future paid role when we scale.
responsibilities: Create content for Instagram, LinkedIn, X(Twitter), or Reddit
Use AI tools to generate images, videos, or content
Write posts or captions for social media
Edit simple images or videos (Canva or similar)
Research trends and suggest content ideas
Help grow Ekthaa's social media presence
Experiment with creative and out-of-the-box  content ideas
Write and post engaging comments under Instagram reels and other social media posts for growth and visibility
(ANY ONE)
requirements: Can commit 1–2 hours per day
Good English communication (basic is enough)
Must have at least one skill from writing, editing, or content creation
Interest in startups, content, or AI tools
Self-motivated and consistent
Laptop or mobile with internet
preferred: Image or video editing using AI tools
Familiar with AI tools like Nano Banana or similar free AI tools

title: Business Calling & Communication Intern (Direct Joining)
commitment: Flexible - Your pace (1 call per week / 1 call per month / or more)
description: A zero-pressure, direct-joining internship at Ekthaa for introverts who want to build confidence by talking to real business owners. No interview. No resume. No targets.
introduction:
If you're an introvert, you're already hired.
At Ekthaa, we're building a platform to help local businesses grow and at the same time, we want to help you grow your confidence.
This is a direct joining internship:
No interview
No resume
No drama
Just onboarding and starting
This is an unpaid internship, but it gives you something most paid internships don't:
A safe, real environment to become comfortable talking to people.
Important:
We do not force you to take calls.
You decide your pace. You can take:
1 call per week
1 call per month
Or more totally your choice
How it works:
You don't have to call anyone
Businesses will call you
Your role is to talk to them and explain Ekthaa
If you perform extraordinarily well, there is a real chance of getting hired in the future.
No pressure. No targets. No forcing.
Just real growth, at your speed.
responsibilities: Answer calls from business owners
Explain Ekthaa in a simple and clear way
Help businesses understand how the platform works
Communicate politely and professionally
Learn and improve your communication skills over time
Represent Ekthaa in conversations
requirements: Willingness to talk to people (even if you're nervous)
Basic English or Telugu/Hindi communication is enough
Smartphone and internet connection
Can give a small amount of time occasionally
No prior experience needed
Introverts and shy people are welcome
preferred: Basic understanding of apps or startups
Curiosity to learn how real startups work
